title: Handoff Brieflet + Econ Snapshot for CS Request Buckets
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create a lightweight, repeatable "brieflet" that CS/Sales can attach to every aggregated enterprise feature bucket. The brieflet should capture: 1) one-line customer problem, 2) target cohort and priority signal, 3) one-sentence solution hypothesis, 4) rough implementation scope (front/back/infra), and 5) an initial econ snapshot (T-shirt cost, likely benefit vector). Goal: enable PMs to make a ~10-minute intake decision and route for discovery vs. backlog without lengthy follow-ups.
acceptance_criteria: A standardized brieflet template exists and is documented in the intake Confluence page
CS and Sales pilots can fill the brieflet in under 12 minutes on average
PM can make a go/no-go + priority recommendation within one 30-minute review using the brieflet
Econ snapshot fields map to the high-touch pricing model and show estimated monthly token impact
At least two pilot accounts (Enterprise A + Enterprise B) have used the brieflet and provided feedback

Instrument pilot telemetry: time-to-fill, PM decision time, and routing outcomes

If pilot meets acceptance criteria, add brieflet as required attachment on 'enterprise request' intake flow in Console
